source: Méribel valley and the Saint-Martin runs Cherferie, Jérusalem and Verdet: the 3 Vallées live piste status page (les3vallees.com/fr/live/ouverture-des-pistes-et-remontees), a typed list with a coloured dot per run (#32A071 green, #00A0FF blue, #D71B0D red, #000 black). Courchevel valley (no typed list on that page): the Courchevel piste map PDF (les3vallees.com/media/download/plan-courchevel.pdf), run labels are real text; the nearest coloured run line to each label was found by script and every disagreement with OpenStreetMap was read by eye from enlarged crops.
names_note: The live list's names differ from the map's for: Boulevard Loze = Boulevard de la Loze; Bouvreuil Bleue = Bouvreuil bleu; Bouvreuil Rouge = Bouvreuil rouge; Bumpy Run - Bump'N'Jump = Bumpy Run; Chamois - 1 = Chamois; Chamois - 2 = Chamois; Chardonneret Bleue = Chardonneret; Chatelet = Châtelet; Combe Tougnète = Combe de Tougnète; Combe du laitelet = Combe du Laitelet; Couloir Tournier Vertical Xperience = Couloir Tournier; Ecureuil = Écureuil; Eterlou = Éterlou; Gelinotte = Gélinotte; Jerusalem = Jérusalem; Jn'Bee = Jn'bee; Little Himalaya = Little Himalaya (Yeti Park); Mauduit - 1 = Mauduit; Mauduit - 2 = Mauduit; Mauduit - 3 = Mauduit; Mûres Rouges = Mures Rouges; Piste Des Animaux = Piste des animaux; Piste Des Inuits = Piste des Inuits; Roc De Fer = Roc de Fer; Snowpark - Boardercross = Boardercross; Speedy Run - Bump'N'Jump = Speedy Run; Tetras = Tétras. Chamois - 1/2 and Mauduit - 1/2/3 are one OpenStreetMap run each.

lifts_explained.Loupiot: beginner lift on the resort's list, not mapped in OpenStreetMap (none found within 6 km)
